class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, lane=None, width=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1, self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(256), nn.LayerNorm(256)
        self.qkv, self.out = nn.Linear(256, 768), nn.Linear(256, 256)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(256, 1024), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(1024, 256))
        self.lane = lane
        if lane == 'tape_lm':
            self.cell = TapeCell(256, TapeHeadConfig(n_heads=4, budget=2944))
            self.read_out = nn.Linear(512, 256)
        elif lane == 'base_lm':
            self.extra = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(256, width), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(width, 256))

    def forward(self, x, ids):
        b, t, _ = x.shape
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.norm1(x)).reshape(b,t,3,4,64).permute(2,0,3,1,4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(rope(q), rope(k), v, is_causal=True)
        x = x+self.out(a.transpose(1,2).reshape(b,t,256))
        h = self.norm2(x)
        x = x+self.ff(h)
        metrics = None
        if self.lane == 'tape_lm':
            read, state, trace, pressure = self.cell(h.float(), ids)
            metrics = trace_metrics(state, trace, pressure)
            x = x+self.read_out(read.flatten(2))
        elif self.lane == 'base_lm':
            x = x+self.extra(h)
        return x, metrics

class MemoryBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,d):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1=nn.LayerNorm(d);self.norm2=nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.input=nn.Identity() if d==256 else nn.Linear(d,256)
        self.cell=Cell(VOCAB)
        self.read_out=nn.Linear(512,d)
        self.ff=nn.Identity()
        # Pilot-family ignition v1: all policies actively write.
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.cell.W_write.weight.zero_();self.cell.W_write.bias.fill_(2.)
            self.cell.match_coef.zero_();self.cell.error_coef.zero_()
        self.cell.W_write.requires_grad_(False)
        self.cell.match_coef.requires_grad_(False);self.cell.error_coef.requires_grad_(False)
    def forward(self,x,ids):
        with torch.autocast('cuda',enabled=False):
            read=self.cell(self.input(self.norm1(x)).float(),ids).flatten(2)
        x=x+self.read_out(read)
        return x+self.ff(self.norm2(x))

class LM(GeometryLM):
    def __init__(self, arm='0.01', vocab=32768):
        if arm not in ARMS:
            raise ValueError(arm)
        super().__init__('c', vocab)
        self.diversity_lambda = float(arm)
        self.read = None
        self.blocks[2].cell.register_forward_hook(self._capture)

    def _capture(self, module, inputs, output):
        self.read = output
        if not self.training:
            _, pairs, coverage = read_diversity(output)
            module.telemetry['read_cosine_pairs'] = pairs.tolist()
            module.telemetry['read_cosine_mean'] = float(pairs.mean())
            module.telemetry['read_nonzero_pair_coverage'] = coverage.tolist()
            module.telemetry['slot_usage_js'] = None
            module.telemetry['slot_usage_status'] = 'disabled outside story evaluation'
            if getattr(self,'measure_slots',False):
                module.telemetry.update(slot_usage(module,*inputs,output))

    def objective(self, logits, targets):
        ce = F.cross_entropy(logits.flatten(0, 1), targets.flatten())
        penalty, _, _ = read_diversity(self.read)
        self.read = None  # do not retain a training graph between steps
        return ce + self.diversity_lambda*penalty
